## Checklist

- [ ] PR title (squash merge) or every commit subject (rebase merge) follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, …) — drives the next release version
- [ ] Commits are signed (recommended, not required) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-signing-recommended)
- [ ] Tests added/updated where relevant
